142.canonical: Never let the agent self-certify its own work: before treating a task as done, spawn a dedicated adversarial reviewer subagent that inspects the output and acceptance criteria in a fresh context, fix any blocking correctness/requirement findings, and re-review.

154.canonical: Do not rely on Zero Data Retention for Agent Skills: Skill definitions and execution data fall under Anthropic's standard retention policy, so keep ZDR-required sensitive data out of Skills.

156.canonical: Test each Skill against every model it will run on and write instructions that work across all target models, giving enough concrete detail for the least-capable model without over-explaining for the strongest.

157.canonical: Author valid SKILL.md frontmatter: a name of at most 64 characters using only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens with no XML tags or reserved words ('anthropic'/'claude'), and a non-empty description of at most 1024 characters with no XML tags.

160.canonical: Always use forward-slash file paths in skill instructions and references so skills work across platforms.

161.canonical: When multiple tools or approaches could work, give one sensible default with an escape hatch, mentioning alternatives only briefly rather than presenting many equal options.

163.canonical: Bundle reusable deterministic scripts for recurring, mechanically-checkable operations and instruct the agent to run them by default instead of regenerating or reading equivalent code, because bundled scripts are more reliable, token-cheaper, faster, and more consistent.

164.canonical: When inputs can be rendered as images, have Claude analyze them visually to reason about spatial layout, form structure, and other visual properties.

170.canonical: Retrieve a Skill-generated file through the Files API: extract its file ID from the code-execution tool result (checking both Python and bash result block types) and download the content.
